svg.title: Character CNN · eight classes
svg.desc: Each poem is four ordered padas (Seesamu uses its body only). Each pada is normalized and mapped to character IDs (102 characters plus PAD and UNK). A shared 104 by 64 embedding with dropout feeds three parallel Conv1D branches with kernel sizes 3, 5 and 7, each with 64 channels and ReLU, followed by masked max and masked mean pooling over positions, giving 384 features per pada. The four pada vectors are concatenated in source order into 1,536 features. Dropout, a 1,536 to 128 linear layer with ReLU, dropout and a 128 to 8 linear layer give eight logits per poem, and an uncalibrated softmax gives the prediction over ఉత్పలమాల, చంపకమాల, మత్తేభము, శార్దూలం, ఆటవెలది, తేటగీతి, కందము and సీసము. 266,056 parameters in total.
svg.text: One shared encoder reads each of the four padas; their vectors are joined in order and classified once per poem.
every pada passes through the same encoder · shared weights
Unicode NFC · whitespace normalized · overflow raises, never truncates
104 × 64 table (102 characters + PAD + UNK) · padding zeroed · dropout 0.2
Concatenate padas P1 | P2 | P3 | P4
Position is kept, so odd and even padas
Hidden layer sees all four padas at once
Eight logits per poem · class-weighted cross-entropy in training
L = characters per pada · step 07 values are illustrative
